set.body: Current public GroupEngine benchmark on Apple M3 Max/JDK25, 100 subjects x 4 terms x 200000 samples: FE median 0.961 s wall / 0.772 s calling-thread CPU / 432 MB calling-thread allocation per fit; DL 2.148 s / 1.454 s / 859 MB. Inputs and outputs remain dense; FE and DL process peak RSS ~1.36 and 1.64 GB under a 3 GB heap. Source allocates factors, small matrices and solver objects per sample, retains a full first weighted pass for DL, and materializes reciprocal/reweighted variance matrices. Shared host had very high load and early measured iterations retain JIT transients: timings are exploratory, not an SLA or release performance gate. Owner: ScalaFIM group buffer/planning/execution with generic linear algebra in Gale. Coordinate manifest-backed spatial blocking at bd-01KX6G9BFJRERNFRWR17WT0YGN. Acceptance: preserve audited results and failure contracts, measure equivalent completed work with longer warmup/multiple forks on a controlled host, track peak memory and allocation separately, reduce per-sample allocations and unnecessary full matrices without weakening numerical conditioning, qualify both JVM/JS behavior. Audit bd-01M20MJY5QG8F7X2ZQENTTWPD7.
set.title: Reduce group weighted-fit allocations with bounded execution evidence
